items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Jaguars; Tank Dell also OUT.
items.why: Groin injury; no travel with team.
items.implication: Clear path for backup RB committee lead (Marks/Ogunbowale) in London game.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snap/carry share for Texans RB2/3; goal-line and third-down upside shifts.

items.text: Jalen Hurts ruled out indefinitely for Week 6 (and beyond until resolved) due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; Tanner McKee expected to start.
items.why: Movement detected in superficial blood clot after playing through initial diagnosis in London; health priority.
items.implication: Eagles offense without dual-threat QB; streamer or McKee dart in 2QB/superflex; reduced rushing upside for Eagles skill players.
items.opportunity: Increased dropbacks/passing volume potential for remaining Eagles weapons if McKee is pass-heavy.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore did not practice for second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Availability concern for Bills WR corps.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to other Bills receivers if limited/OUT.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love did not practice for second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.implication: Elevated risk of missing or limited Week 6 role.
items.opportunity: Other Cardinals RBs gain carries if limited/OUT.

items.text: Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited. Barkley trending toward missing second straight game.
items.implication: High risk of OUT; Eagles thin at RB with other injuries.
items.opportunity: Backup RB (Pierce/Steele) elevated snaps/carries/red-zone if OUT; Smith limited but progressing.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again Thursday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Questionable/OUT risk elevates other Chiefs WRs/TE targets.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and Travis Kelce route/target share increase if inactive.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again Thursday (ankle).
items.implication: GTD or OUT risk; Huntley potential start impacts Ravens skill players.
items.opportunity: If OUT, reduced overall offense but possible checkdown upside for Andrews/Likely/Flowers.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week out (high ankle); Rhamondre Stevenson borderline RB1 with 85% snaps/23 touches in prior full game without him. Loves Kyren Williams and Javonte Williams too for volume/goal-line.
items.why: Henderson multi-week high ankle; Stevenson proven volume; others elite usage/matchups.
items.implication: Stevenson locked RB1/2 start; clear handcuff elevation.
items.opportunity: Feature back snaps/carries/red-zone for Stevenson; Kyren/Javonte secure roles.

items.text: Post-Breece Hall injury, Braelon Allen dominated snaps (90) vs Isaiah Davis (12) and Kene Nwangwu (0) in two full games; Hall remains week-to-week, no practice.
items.why: Clear snap dominance by Allen in Hall's absence; Hall week-to-week.
items.implication: Allen is the primary handcuff/lead back while Hall out; high opportunity share.
items.opportunity: Near-feature back snaps/carries for Allen; roster priority handcuff.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return in TNF due to shoulder injury (later returned).
items.implication: In-game limitation risk; monitor for residual effects ROS.
items.opportunity: Temporary target share to other Broncos WRs if exits.

items.text: Saquon Barkley turns 30 in February; Eagles historically move on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz). Contenders with RB need should call; better a year early than late.
items.why: Age + Eagles precedent of early moves on veterans; current hamstring issues.
items.implication: Potential trade candidate or reduced long-term role; monitor for team interest.
items.conflict: Conflicts with pure usage if healthy and featured.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans as WR4 this week vs Commanders; Washington defense buffet for pass catchers. Also high on Drake London, George Kittle vs same defense, and Matthew Golden.
items.why: Elite matchup vs WSH pass defense; Evans high target share recently with Deebo out multi-week.
items.implication: Strong start candidates; Kittle TE3 upside.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone volume in favorable spots.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28, poor production outside one game, tough SEA matchup), Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts; also Bo Nix (scared play, tough defense) and Justin Herbert (low total).
items.why: Ugly matchups, shaky QB play/volume, recent underperformance (Waddle 67% yards in one game).
items.conflict: Waddle mid-game shoulder adds further risk.

items.text: Ja'Kobi Lane (Ravens rookie WR) expected back to practice post-wrist surgery; had elite camp buzz and shot at big role. Returns to high-YPP offense (6.4) even without full Lamar snaps.
items.why: Four weeks post-surgery; HC says shot to play; prior elite YPP/buzz.
items.implication: Potential immediate depth chart climber and flex/stash; Bateman competition.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in efficient Ravens offense if active and involved.
